description: This file defines the MyAttendanceRecordAPI class, which extends EmployeeAttendanceRecordAPI and provides API endpoints related to employee attendance records, such as extracting punch date-times with validation, and checking user permissions for punch actions within the OrangeHRM attendance module.

classes.name: MyAttendanceRecordAPI
classes.description: API class for managing and retrieving employee attendance records, including time validation and user permission checks.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number of the authenticated user.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Modifies validation rules for retrieving all attendance records, removing employee number validation.

methods.name: extractPunchDateTime
methods.description: Converts a datetime string into a DateTime object adjusted for timezone, with validation to prevent unauthorized modifications.

methods.name: isCurrantDateTimeValid
methods.description: Checks if the provided user datetime matches the system's current time within a 180-second margin, for validation.

methods.name: userAllowedPunchInActions
methods.description: Checks if the user is permitted to punch in based on allowed actions.

methods.name: userAllowedPunchOutActions
methods.description: Checks if the user is permitted to punch out based on allowed actions.
